scores.notes: The dripping man on the left has dark curly hair with a greying beard; the diving Peter on the right has clearly grey hair and beard.
Peter stepping from the boat has dark hair and a dark greying beard; the diving Peter is clearly grey-haired and older.
Viewed: on the cross Jesus is a small distant figure; long dark hair and a beard can be made out and do not conflict, but the face is too small to compare.
Viewed: Moses stands on the rock turned away from the viewer; white hair, a white beard edge, mantle and crook agree, but the face cannot be compared.
